title: National Antique Tractor Pull - Carl Buckner Classic Qualifier
seo_title: National Antique Tractor Pull Qualifier in Lebanon, MO
description: The National Antique Tractor Pull - Carl Buckner Classic Qualifier is a tractor pulling event where you can watch pullers compete to qualify for the National Championship Pull. It takes place on Saturday, January 2, 2027 at 8:00 AM at the Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street in Lebanon, Missouri.
